headlines.title: France's Bond Risk Is Outpacing Italy's by Most in Euro History
headlines.summary: When France starts trading wider than Italy on the credit tape, that's not a footnote — that's a five-alarm fire in the sovereign bond market. This hits European banks, the euro, and anything with EM contagion exposure; Krugman's 'too big to save' comment on the same day pours gasoline on it. Watch the CAC, European financials, and the long bond for the ripple.

headlines.title: Delta Air Lines cuts 2026 forecast on fuel surge, but CEO says demand is still strong
headlines.summary: Delta missing the Street for the first time in two years and cutting its full-year number is the kind of print that moves the whole airline sector — United, American, Southwest all get dragged through the mud on sympathy. With Brent north of $100, this is a real-time earnings warning for every fuel-heavy business on the tape, not just the carriers.

headlines.title: SpaceX deal to acquire spectrum license hammers shares of AT&T, Verizon and T-Mobile
headlines.summary: Starlink buying a nationwide 800 MHz spectrum portfolio is a direct shot across the bow of the big three telecoms — this isn't a satellite side hustle anymore, it's a land grab for the mobile market. AT&T, Verizon, and T-Mobile all take a hit while cell-tower names get a bid on the infrastructure angle. Competitive disruption stories like this have legs beyond one session.
